ios.desc:
Blocks Party! is a modern and relaxing block puzzle game that blends classic gameplay with fresh mechanics, progression systems, and competitive features.
Place blocks, clear lines, collect gems, unlock new themes, and challenge yourself across multiple game modes - whether you want to relax or compete for the top spots.

GAME MODES
Enjoy multiple carefully designed modes for different play styles:
• King of the Hill - Classic endless mode. Play without time limits and score as many points as possible.
• Time Rush - Beat the clock. Make fast decisions and maximize your score before time runs out.
• Expedition - 72 unique levels generated every week. Complete objectives, collect gems, and climb the weekly leaderboard.

Each mode offers its own challenges and rewards.

THEMES
Customize your experience with beautiful visual themes.
Switch between different styles to match your mood - from calm and minimal to vibrant and energetic.
New themes can be unlocked through gameplay progression or optional purchases.

GEMS & PROGRESSION
Collect gems during gameplay to complete objectives and unlock content.
Progress naturally as you play - the game rewards both casual sessions and long-term dedication.

GAME CENTER
Compete and track your progress with full Game Center integration:
• Leaderboards - Compare your scores with players worldwide across all game modes.
• Achievements - Unlock achievements for milestones like high scores, total progress, and special challenges.
• Weekly Competition - Expedition leaderboards reset every week, giving everyone a fresh chance to reach the top.

IN-APP PURCHASES
Blocks Party! is fully playable for free. Optional in-app purchases are available:
• All Themes: Instantly unlock all visual themes.
• No Ads: Remove ads for uninterrupted gameplay.

These purchases are not required to enjoy or complete the game.
